geometry_edits.rationale: Wrap the book-mutated dominant mass with a clearer public-void logic by changing the final recombination to preserve a more readable court-like subtraction outcome.
Add a courtyard macro to articulate a usable public void at the ground edge while preserving the dominant stepped mass.
Create a substantial but not excessive court depth so the void reads publicly and supports neighborhood living.
Open the court to the verified access side in the program frame to reinforce the street-facing threshold.
Make the courtyard-enhanced mass the root so the new public void becomes part of the compiled dominant geometry.

graph_edits.rationale: Convert the existing cave into a clearer public court to strengthen the ground threshold without disturbing the dominant stepped bar.
Use a sufficiently large court margin to produce a legible void that reads as usable public space rather than a minor notch.
Align the opening to the site access side in the program frame so the frontage becomes a public threshold.

rationale: The candidate reads as one dominant compact bar-like mass with stepped reduction, and it remains coherent across all four views. The parcel is respected and the silhouette is not arbitrarily fragmented or colliding. The main weakness is programmatic: for neighborhood living/commercial, the mass currently behaves more like a generic stepped object than a clearly active street building. The blue access edge is acknowledged only weakly; there is no strong public void, court, or undercut aligned to the frontage. Still, the form can plausibly support the brief because the section is calm, capacity-aware, and not typologically alien.
